title: Air Ticket Fare Brands: Voluntary Change Charges Carried into the Money Collected
content:
Voluntary change lines standing on an air booking are carried into the money collected on that booking under the Air Ticket Fare Brands terms according to two matters read together: whether such lines stand on the booking at all, and the form in which the fare brand held returns value.

**The clauses.** Where voluntary change lines stand on the booking and the fare brand held returns value on a travel credit, the share carried is 1.0, so the whole of what those lines were charged is added to the money collected. Where voluntary change lines stand on the booking and the fare brand held returns value to the original form of payment, the share carried is 0.5, so half of what those lines were charged is added to the money collected. Otherwise nothing of the voluntary change lines is added to the money collected.

**The bases of judgement.**

| Voluntary change lines standing on the booking | Form in which the fare brand held returns value | Share of those charges carried into the money collected |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Yes | On a travel credit | 1.0 |
| Yes | To the original form of payment | 0.5 |
| No | On a travel credit | Nothing carried |
| No | To the original form of payment | Nothing carried |

Both limbs must hold together. Where no line on the booking is a voluntary change line, nothing of those charges is carried into the money collected, whatever form the fare brand held returns value in; where such lines do stand, the share carried is settled by that form alone.

**Worked on hypothetical figures.** Take voluntary change lines charged at 150.00 US dollars on a booking. Where the fare brand held returns value on a travel credit, the share carried is 1.0 and 150.00 US dollars is added to the money collected. Where the fare brand held returns value to the original form of payment, the share carried is 0.5 and 75.00 US dollars is added to the money collected. Where no voluntary change line stands on the booking, nothing is added to the money collected on this account.
